reviews.text: The color "Bare Essential" I purchased is the mlbb toned down beige pink color. A bit reminds me of Rom&nd zero matte lipstick in 23 Ruddy Nude, which I also happen to like. It's a good everyday color to wear.
reviews.zh: 我買嘅「Bare Essential」係MLBB色調嘅低調裸粉紅。有少少似Rom&nd zero matte lipstick嘅23 Ruddy Nude，嗰支我都好鍾意。日常返好用嘅顏色。

reviews.text: The color "Indicate" I purchased is good for everyday wear, but especially fall or winter, I think. It's toned down mauve beige color, which surprisingly flatters the warm-toned such as myself.
reviews.zh: 我買嘅「Indicate」日常返都啱用，但特別啱秋冬，我覺得。係低調嘅豆沙裸色，意外地襯托到我呢種暖調肌膚。

reviews.text: I thought the color is more subtle but it is very intense pigmentation. I do not like matte lipstick because this is also hard to blend on my dry lips. I wear this on a hot day, it is way better because it is blendable.
reviews.zh: 本來以為色調會比較含蓄，但顯色度非常強。本身唔鍾意霧面唇膏，因為喺我乾嘅唇上好難推開。喺大熱天用就好好多，因為推得開。

reviews.text: I discovered the brand hince recently and got the viral highlighter first, but this one is such a good lipstich and beautiful pink color. The brand logo on top is just very stylish too.
reviews.zh: 最近先認識hince呢個品牌，最初買咗佢哋嘅人氣打亮產品，但呢支唇膏都好好用，粉色好靚。蓋上面嘅品牌logo都好有型。

reviews.text: It is totally for cool tone skins, little too purple for me! So sorry that I was not able to return or exchange after trying it on…. Will gift to a friend
reviews.zh: 完全係冷調肌膚用嘅顏色，對我嚟講紫咗少少！好可惜試咗之後冇辦法退或者換……會轉贈畀朋友。

reviews.text:
☑️ non-drying formulation
☑️ vivid color playoff (even on highly pigmented lips)
☑️ suitable MLBB shade for warm tones
☑️ long lasting (make sure you let it set)

Basically, a really good lipstick!
reviews.zh:
☑️ 唔乾嘅配方
☑️ 顯色鮮明（就算喺深唇色上面都係）
☑️ 啱暖調肌膚嘅MLBB色
☑️ 持久（要記得等佢定妝）

總括嚟講，真係一支好唇膏！

reviews.text:
Beautiful lipstick! 
☑️rich color & complementary to fair-medium skin tone
☑️creamy matte texture 
☑️surprisingly long lasting 

I’m a 22-23 shade in cushion foundations and this color is extremely flattering. However, it came out a little darker as advertised. Like all matte lipsticks, it does dry out after a few hours and you’ll have to reapply. Still, it’s a great product. 
Happy to recommend!
reviews.zh:
唇膏好靚！
☑️ 顏色飽滿，配襯白至中等膚色
☑️ 奶油霧面質地
☑️ 持久得出乎意料

我用嘅氣墊粉底色號係22-23，呢隻色超級襯我。不過實物比起廣告講嘅深少少。同其他霧面唇膏一樣，用幾個鐘之後會變乾，要重新補塗。不過依然係好產品。
好樂意推薦！

reviews.text: This is the second time I'm buying this shade! Out of all the shades I've gotten, I love this the most. It is very natural matte colour and is very close to my natural lip colour so it doesn't look like I'm wearing heavy lipstick, and it is good for daily wear. The colour is quite long-lasting and is able to last me up till half a day.
reviews.zh: 呢個色號已經係第二次買！買過咁多色入面，呢個我最鍾意。好自然嘅霧面色，非常接近我本身唇色，所以睇落唔似揸咗厚唇膏，日常用好啱。顯色都好持久，可以用到大半日。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
